lec02bi2-scene-u01.name: 後驗保留完整的不確定性

lec02bi2-scene-u02.name: 資料增加使高斯後驗變尖

lec02bi2-scene-u03.name: 預測變異數要加上後驗變異數

lec02bi2-scene-u04.name: 資料多時三種估計一致

lec02bi2-scene-u05.name: 最大熵不偷偷加入假設

lec02bi2-scene-u07.name: 限制條件決定最大熵的答案

lec02bi2-scene-u08.name: 小結：兩個主題各留下什麼

lec02bi2-u01-p1-title1.name: u01 p1 title
lec02bi2-u01-p1-title1.text: 只給一個數字，萬一那個數字錯了？

lec02bi2-u01-p1-sub2.name: u01 p1 sub
lec02bi2-u01-p1-sub2.text: One number only: what if that number is wrong?

lec02bi2-u01-p1-big3.name: u01 p1 big
lec02bi2-u01-p1-big3.text:
ML：「我猜 25 度」
貝氏：「24 到 26 度，中間最可能」
*ML: "I guess 25 degrees."*
*Bayes: "24 to 26, most likely in the middle."*

lec02bi2-u01-p1-note4.name: u01 p1 note
lec02bi2-u01-p1-note4.text:
貝氏推論（Bayesian inference）把「有多不確定」也說清楚。ML 與 MAP 都只給一個數字，你拿它當真實參數往下算，它錯了怎麼辦？
*Bayesian inference also states how unsure we are. ML and MAP return one number that you treat as the true parameter. What if it is wrong?*

lec02bi2-u01-p1-supp5.name: u01 p1 supp
lec02bi2-u01-p1-supp5.text:
[補充] 比喻的侷限：氣溫的不確定性不完全等於參數的不確定性。
*[Added] Limit of the analogy: weather uncertainty is not exactly parameter uncertainty.*

lec02bi2-u01-p2-title1.name: u01 p2 title
lec02bi2-u01-p2-title1.text: 貝氏推論保留所有可能的 θ

lec02bi2-u01-p2-sub2.name: u01 p2 sub
lec02bi2-u01-p2-sub2.text: Bayesian inference keeps every possible θ

lec02bi2-u01-p2-prior3.name: u01 p2 prior
lec02bi2-u01-p2-prior3.text:
**先驗** (prior)
$p(\theta)$
看資料前的把握
*belief before the data*

lec02bi2-u01-p2-post4.name: u01 p2 post
lec02bi2-u01-p2-post4.text:
**後驗** (posterior)
$p(\theta\mid X)$
看完資料後的把握
*belief after the data*

lec02bi2-u01-p2-pred5.name: u01 p2 pred
lec02bi2-u01-p2-pred5.text:
**預測分布** (predictive)
$p(x\mid X)$
新樣本的完整分布
*distribution of a new sample*

lec02bi2-u01-p2-plain8.name: u01 p2 plain
lec02bi2-u01-p2-plain8.text:
**白話**：不挑單一的 $\theta$，把所有可能的 $\theta$ 都留下來，各帶一個權重。$X$ 是訓練資料，$x$ 是新樣本。
*Plain words: do not pick a single $\theta$; keep every possible $\theta$, each with a weight. $X$ is the training data and $x$ a new sample.*

lec02bi2-u01-p3-title1.name: u01 p3 title
lec02bi2-u01-p3-title1.text: 預測分布是後驗加權的平均

lec02bi2-u01-p3-sub2.name: u01 p3 sub
lec02bi2-u01-p3-sub2.text: The predictive distribution is a posterior-weighted average

lec02bi2-u01-p3-note5.name: u01 p3 note
lec02bi2-u01-p3-note5.text:
白話：把每個可能的 $\theta$ 代進 $p(x\mid\theta)$ 算一次，再依 $\theta$ 有多可能做加權平均。
*Plain words: plug every possible $\theta$ into $p(x\mid\theta)$, then average, weighted by how likely each $\theta$ is.*

lec02bi2-u01-p4-title1.name: u01 p4 title
lec02bi2-u01-p4-title1.text: 15 個加權項重現這個積分

lec02bi2-u01-p4-sub2.name: u01 p4 sub
lec02bi2-u01-p4-sub2.text: Fifteen weighted terms reproduce the integral

lec02bi2-u01-p4-fig3.name: u01 f1
lec02bi2-u01-p4-fig3.text: 左圖:15 條淡青色細線是各個 p(x|θ) 依後驗加權的結果,橘色粗線是它們的和;右圖:這個加權和(橘色虛線)與解析的預測分布 N(1.9048, 1.4762)(藍色實線)幾乎重合

image.alt: 左圖:15 條淡青色細線是各個 p(x|θ) 依後驗加權的結果,橘色粗線是它們的和;右圖:這個加權和(橘色虛線)與解析的預測分布 N(1.9048, 1.4762)(藍色實線)幾乎重合

lec02bi2-u01-p4-cap4.name: u01 p4 cap
lec02bi2-u01-p4-cap4.text:
設定：$\sigma^2=1$、先驗 $\mathcal{N}(0,10)$、$\bar{x}_N=2$、$N=2$。左：每條細線是一個 $p(x\mid\theta)$，依後驗加權；右：加權和與積分結果幾乎重合。
*Setting: $\sigma^2=1$, prior $\mathcal{N}(0,10)$, $\bar{x}_N=2$, $N=2$. Left: each thin curve is one $p(x\mid\theta)$ weighted by the posterior. Right: the weighted sum nearly equals the integral.*

lec02bi2-u01-p5-title1.name: u01 p5 title
lec02bi2-u01-p5-title1.text: 貝氏推論不只是換種點估計

lec02bi2-u01-p5-sub2.name: u01 p5 sub
lec02bi2-u01-p5-sub2.text: Bayesian inference is not just another point estimate

lec02bi2-u01-p5-wrong3.name: u01 p5 wrong
lec02bi2-u01-p5-wrong3.text:
✗  「貝氏推論只是換一種方法算點估計。」
*"Bayesian inference is just another way to compute a point estimate."*

lec02bi2-u01-p5-right4.name: u01 p5 right
lec02bi2-u01-p5-right4.text:
✓  它輸出整個分布，多出「不確定性有多大」的資訊。
*It returns a whole distribution, which also tells how large the uncertainty is.*

lec02bi2-u01-p5-supp5.name: u01 p5 supp
lec02bi2-u01-p5-supp5.text:
[補充] 這個積分多半沒有公式解，實務上靠數值方法：MCMC、Gibbs 抽樣、Metropolis-Hastings。
*[Added] This integral usually has no closed form; in practice use MCMC, Gibbs sampling or Metropolis-Hastings.*

lec02bi2-u02-p1-title1.name: u02 p1 title
lec02bi2-u02-p1-title1.text: 高斯先驗更新後仍是高斯

lec02bi2-u02-p1-sub2.name: u02 p1 sub
lec02bi2-u02-p1-sub2.text: A Gaussian prior stays Gaussian after the update

lec02bi2-u02-p1-note4.name: u02 p1 note
lec02bi2-u02-p1-note4.text:
資料來自一維高斯，$\sigma^2$ 已知、$\mu$ 未知，先驗是 $\mathcal{N}(\mu_0,\sigma_0^2)$。後驗仍是高斯，參數有公式解。
*1-D Gaussian data, known $\sigma^2$, unknown $\mu$, prior $\mathcal{N}(\mu_0,\sigma_0^2)$. The posterior is Gaussian again, with closed-form parameters.*

lec02bi2-u02-p1-supp5.name: u02 p1 supp
lec02bi2-u02-p1-supp5.text:
$N$ 樣本數、$\bar{x}_N$ 樣本平均、$\mu_0,\sigma_0^2$ 先驗、$\mu_N,\sigma_N^2$ 後驗。
*$N$ samples, $\bar{x}_N$ sample mean, $\mu_0,\sigma_0^2$ prior, $\mu_N,\sigma_N^2$ posterior.*

lec02bi2-u02-p2-title1.name: u02 p2 title
lec02bi2-u02-p2-title1.text: 後驗均值是先驗與資料的加權平均

lec02bi2-u02-p2-sub2.name: u02 p2 sub
lec02bi2-u02-p2-sub2.text: The posterior mean is a weighted average of prior and data

lec02bi2-u02-p2-main3.name: u02 p2 main
lec02bi2-u02-p2-main3.text:
**後驗均值** (posterior mean) $\mu_N$

是先驗 $\mu_0$ 與樣本平均 $\bar{x}_N$ 的加權平均。
*A weighted average of the prior mean $\mu_0$ and the sample mean $\bar{x}_N$.*

$N$ 越大，權重越偏向資料。
*Larger $N$ puts more weight on the data.*

lec02bi2-u02-p2-side14.name: u02 p2 side1
lec02bi2-u02-p2-side14.text:
**後驗變異數** (posterior variance) $\sigma_N^2$
隨 $N$ 變大而縮小，大致以 $1/N$ 的速度。
*Shrinks roughly like $1/N$.*

lec02bi2-u02-p2-side25.name: u02 p2 side2
lec02bi2-u02-p2-side25.text:
以 $\bar{x}_N=2$ 為例：後驗均值從 $0$ 往 $2$ 移動。
*With $\bar{x}_N=2$ the posterior mean moves from $0$ toward $2$.*

lec02bi2-u02-p3-title1.name: u02 p3 title
lec02bi2-u02-p3-title1.text: N 越大，後驗越準也越窄

lec02bi2-u02-p3-sub2.name: u02 p3 sub
lec02bi2-u02-p3-sub2.text: Larger N gives a more accurate, narrower posterior

lec02bi2-u02-p4-title1.name: u02 p4 title
lec02bi2-u02-p4-title1.text: 資料增加使後驗越來越尖

lec02bi2-u02-p4-sub2.name: u02 p4 sub
lec02bi2-u02-p4-sub2.text: More data makes the posterior sharper

lec02bi2-u02-p4-fig3.name: u02 f2
lec02bi2-u02-p4-fig3.text: 灰色虛線是先驗 N(0,10);橘色由淺到深的四條曲線是 N=1、2、5、20 的後驗,越來越高越窄,中心靠近真實均值 2(琥珀色點劃線)

image.alt: 灰色虛線是先驗 N(0,10);橘色由淺到深的四條曲線是 N=1、2、5、20 的後驗,越來越高越窄,中心靠近真實均值 2(琥珀色點劃線)

lec02bi2-u02-p4-cap14.name: u02 p4 cap1
lec02bi2-u02-p4-cap14.text:
灰色虛線是先驗 $\mathcal{N}(0,10)$；橘色由淺到深是 $N=1,2,5,20$ 的後驗。
*Grey dashed: the prior. Orange, light to dark: posteriors for $N=1,2,5,20$.*

lec02bi2-u02-p4-cap25.name: u02 p4 cap2
lec02bi2-u02-p4-cap25.text:
琥珀色點劃線是真實均值 $\mu^*=2$。$N$ 越大，曲線越高越窄，中心越靠近 $2$。
*Amber dash-dot: true mean $\mu^*=2$. Larger $N$: higher, narrower, closer to $2$.*

lec02bi2-u02-p5-big3.name: u02 p5 big
lec02bi2-u02-p5-big3.text:
資料越多，後驗越尖。
不確定性不是消失，而是被資料壓縮。
*More data makes the posterior sharper.*
*Uncertainty is not gone; it is squeezed by the data.*

lec02bi2-u03-p1-title1.name: u03 p1 title
lec02bi2-u03-p1-title1.text: 預測變異數＝樣本亂度＋後驗變異數

lec02bi2-u03-p1-sub2.name: u03 p1 sub
lec02bi2-u03-p1-sub2.text: Predictive variance = sample noise + posterior variance

lec02bi2-u03-p1-note4.name: u03 p1 note
lec02bi2-u03-p1-note4.text:
注意：變異數是 $\sigma^2+\sigma_N^2$，不是 $\sigma^2$。多出的一項，來自「還不完全確定 $\mu$」。
*Note: the variance is $\sigma^2+\sigma_N^2$, not $\sigma^2$. The extra term comes from not knowing $\mu$ exactly.*

lec02bi2-u03-p2-title1.name: u03 p2 title
lec02bi2-u03-p2-title1.text: 兩種不確定性疊在一起

lec02bi2-u03-p2-left3.name: u03 p2 left
lec02bi2-u03-p2-left3.text:
**樣本本身的亂度** (sample noise)
$\sigma^2$
即使知道 $\mu$，新樣本仍會抖動。
*Even if $\mu$ is known, a new sample still fluctuates.*

lec02bi2-u03-p2-right4.name: u03 p2 right
lec02bi2-u03-p2-right4.text:
**中心還不確定** (parameter uncertainty)
$\sigma_N^2$
資料越多，這一項越小。
*The more data, the smaller this term.*

lec02bi2-u03-p2-sum5.name: u03 p2 sum
lec02bi2-u03-p2-sum5.text:
兩者相加，預測就必須更寬：$\sigma^2+\sigma_N^2$
*Add them, and the prediction must be wider.*

lec02bi2-u03-p3-title1.name: u03 p3 title
lec02bi2-u03-p3-title1.text: 預測分布比代入點估計矮而寬

lec02bi2-u03-p3-sub2.name: u03 p3 sub
lec02bi2-u03-p3-sub2.text: The predictive density is lower and wider than plug-in

lec02bi2-u03-p3-cell12.name: u03 p3 cell
lec02bi2-u03-p3-cell12.text:
代入點估計的峰值
*plug-in peak*

lec02bi2-u03-p3-supp18.name: u03 p3 supp
lec02bi2-u03-p3-supp18.text:
N=2：μ_N=1.9048、σ_N²=0.4762。0.3284 < 0.3989，預測分布更寬、更誠實。
*N=2: μ_N=1.9048, σ_N²=0.4762. 0.3284 < 0.3989, so the predictive density is wider and more honest.*

lec02bi2-u03-p4-title1.name: u03 p4 title
lec02bi2-u03-p4-title1.text: 預測比只代入點估計更寬

lec02bi2-u03-p4-sub2.name: u03 p4 sub
lec02bi2-u03-p4-sub2.text: The prediction is wider than plugging in a point estimate

lec02bi2-u03-p4-fig3.name: u03 f3
lec02bi2-u03-p4-fig3.text: 左圖(N=2):橘色預測分布比藍色只代入 μN 的分布更矮更寬,橘色陰影是兩者的差,灰色虛線的後驗最窄;右圖:預測標準差從 N=1 的 1.3817 降到 N=20 的 1.0246,逐漸貼近藍色虛線 σ=1

image.alt: 左圖(N=2):橘色預測分布比藍色只代入 μN 的分布更矮更寬,橘色陰影是兩者的差,灰色虛線的後驗最窄;右圖:預測標準差從 N=1 的 1.3817 降到 N=20 的 1.0246,逐漸貼近藍色虛線 σ=1

lec02bi2-u03-p4-cap4.name: u03 p4 cap
lec02bi2-u03-p4-cap4.text:
左：$N=2$ 時預測分布（橘）比只代入 $\mu_N$ 的分布（藍）矮而寬，陰影是多出的 $\sigma_N^2$；右：預測標準差從 $1.3817$（$N=1$）降到 $1.0246$（$N=20$）。
*Left: at $N=2$ the predictive density (orange) is lower and wider than the plug-in density (blue); the shading is the extra $\sigma_N^2$. Right: the predictive sd falls from $1.3817$ ($N=1$) to $1.0246$ ($N=20$).*

lec02bi2-u03-p5-title1.name: u03 p5 title
lec02bi2-u03-p5-title1.text: 後驗變異數不是計算誤差，不能丟

lec02bi2-u03-p5-sub2.name: u03 p5 sub
lec02bi2-u03-p5-sub2.text: The posterior variance is not a numerical error: do not drop it

lec02bi2-u03-p5-wrong3.name: u03 p5 wrong
lec02bi2-u03-p5-wrong3.text:
✗
「多出的 $\sigma_N^2$ 是程式算錯，應該忽略。」
*"The extra $\sigma_N^2$ is a bug; ignore it."*

lec02bi2-u03-p5-right4.name: u03 p5 right
lec02bi2-u03-p5-right4.text:
✓
它來自「參數沒有被完全確定」，丟掉就丟掉最重要的不確定性。
*It comes from the parameter not being fully known; dropping it discards the key uncertainty.*

lec02bi2-u03-p5-supp5.name: u03 p5 supp
lec02bi2-u03-p5-supp5.text:
[補充] 反例：小樣本時若硬把 $\sigma_N^2$ 設成 0，預測分布會又高又窄，實際量測落在區間外的機率就比宣稱的高很多。
*[Added] Counter-example: with a small sample, forcing $\sigma_N^2$ to 0 makes the predictive density tall and narrow, so real measurements fall outside the claimed range far more often.*

lec02bi2-u04-p1-title1.name: u04 p1 title
lec02bi2-u04-p1-title1.text: 三種做法保留的資訊不同

lec02bi2-u04-p1-sub2.name: u04 p1 sub
lec02bi2-u04-p1-sub2.text: The three approaches keep different information

lec02bi2-u04-p1-ml3.name: u04 p1 ml
lec02bi2-u04-p1-ml3.text:
**ML**
最大概似
*maximum likelihood*
只給一個數字 $\bar{x}_N$
*returns one number*

lec02bi2-u04-p1-map4.name: u04 p1 map
lec02bi2-u04-p1-map4.text:
**MAP**
最大事後機率
*maximum a posteriori*
給後驗的最高點 $\mu_N$
*returns the posterior peak*

lec02bi2-u04-p1-bayes5.name: u04 p1 bayes
lec02bi2-u04-p1-bayes5.text:
**貝氏推論**
*Bayesian inference*
給整條後驗曲線
$p(\mu\mid X)$
*returns the whole posterior*

lec02bi2-u04-p1-supp6.name: u04 p1 supp
lec02bi2-u04-p1-supp6.text:
貝氏推論資訊最完整，代價是計算最貴。
*Bayesian inference keeps the most information, at the highest computational cost.*

lec02bi2-u04-p2-title1.name: u04 p2 title
lec02bi2-u04-p2-title1.text: N 從 2 變 20，MAP 貼近 ML

lec02bi2-u04-p2-sub2.name: u04 p2 sub
lec02bi2-u04-p2-sub2.text: From N=2 to N=20, MAP moves toward ML

lec02bi2-u04-p2-supp6.name: u04 p2 supp
lec02bi2-u04-p2-supp6.text:
[補充] 這裡 MAP 等於後驗均值，因為後驗是對稱的高斯，均值就是眾數；其他分布不一定如此。
*[Added] Here MAP equals the posterior mean because a symmetric Gaussian has mean = mode; other distributions need not.*

lec02bi2-u04-p3-title1.name: u04 p3 title
lec02bi2-u04-p3-title1.text: 資料多時兩條線幾乎重疊

lec02bi2-u04-p3-sub2.name: u04 p3 sub
lec02bi2-u04-p3-sub2.text: With plenty of data the two lines nearly overlap

lec02bi2-u04-p3-fig3.name: u04 f4
lec02bi2-u04-p3-fig3.text: 左圖(N=2):橘色後驗,藍色虛線 ML=2.000 與琥珀色點劃線 MAP=1.905 相距 0.0952;右圖(N=20):後驗變窄,ML 與 MAP=1.990 只差 0.0100,兩條線幾乎重疊

image.alt: 左圖(N=2):橘色後驗,藍色虛線 ML=2.000 與琥珀色點劃線 MAP=1.905 相距 0.0952;右圖(N=20):後驗變窄,ML 與 MAP=1.990 只差 0.0100,兩條線幾乎重疊

lec02bi2-u04-p3-cap4.name: u04 p3 cap
lec02bi2-u04-p3-cap4.text:
橘色是後驗，藍色虛線是 ML 估計（固定在 $2$），琥珀色點劃線是 MAP 估計。左：$N=2$ 兩線差 $0.0952$；右：$N=20$ 差距縮到 $0.0100$。
*Orange: posterior. Blue dashed: ML estimate (fixed at $2$). Amber dash-dot: MAP estimate. Left: $N=2$, the lines differ by $0.0952$. Right: $N=20$, the gap shrinks to $0.0100$.*

lec02bi2-u04-p4-title1.name: u04 p4 title
lec02bi2-u04-p4-title1.text: 資料多時，三條路走到同一處

lec02bi2-u04-p4-sub2.name: u04 p4 sub
lec02bi2-u04-p4-sub2.text: With plenty of data the three routes meet

lec02bi2-u04-p4-big3.name: u04 p4 big
lec02bi2-u04-p4-big3.text:
資料少時，三條路差很多。
資料多時，三條路走到同一個地方。
*With little data the three routes differ a lot.*
*With plenty of data they arrive at the same place.*

lec02bi2-u04-p4-supp4.name: u04 p4 supp
lec02bi2-u04-p4-supp4.text:
[補充] 為什麼？$\sigma_N^2$ 隨 $N$ 變大趨近 $0$，先驗的影響也被大量資料稀釋。資料少時貝氏推論保留的不確定性資訊最完整，代價是計算最貴。
*[Added] Why? $\sigma_N^2\to 0$ as $N$ grows and a large data set dilutes the prior. With little data Bayesian inference keeps the most uncertainty information, at the highest cost.*

lec02bi2-u05-p1-title1.name: u05 p1 title
lec02bi2-u05-p1-title1.text: 只知道住在台灣，別假設他住台北

lec02bi2-u05-p1-main3.name: u05 p1 main
lec02bi2-u05-p1-main3.text:
**比喻**

只被告知「這個人住在台灣」，你不該假設他住台北。
*If you are only told the person lives in Taiwan, do not assume Taipei.*

假設住台北，就是偷偷加了沒人告訴你的資訊。
*That quietly adds information nobody gave you.*

lec02bi2-u05-p1-side14.name: u05 p1 side1
lec02bi2-u05-p1-side14.text:
已知的線索又少又粗：範圍、均值、分散程度。符合它們的分布有無窮多個。
*Few, rough clues: support, mean, spread. Infinitely many densities fit them.*

lec02bi2-u05-p1-side25.name: u05 p1 side2
lec02bi2-u05-p1-side25.text:
**最大熵原理**
*maximum-entropy principle*
選熵最大、最不多加假設的那一個。
*Pick the largest-entropy density.*

lec02bi2-u05-p2-sub2.name: u05 p2 sub
lec02bi2-u05-p2-sub2.text: Larger entropy means a less committal density

lec02bi2-u05-p2-note4.name: u05 p2 note
lec02bi2-u05-p2-note4.text:
熵（entropy）越大，分布越平均、越不肯把機率集中在少數幾處；熵越小，分布越集中，我們對結果越有把握。
*Larger entropy: the density is flatter and does not concentrate probability. Smaller entropy: more concentrated and more confident.*

lec02bi2-u05-p2-supp5.name: u05 p2 supp
lec02bi2-u05-p2-supp5.text:
$H$ 的單位是 nats（自然對數）。最大熵估計：先寫下所有已知條件，再挑 $H$ 最大的分布。
*$H$ is in nats (natural log). Maximum-entropy estimation: write down all known constraints, then pick the density with the largest $H$.*

lec02bi2-u05-p3-title1.name: u05 p3 title
lec02bi2-u05-p3-title1.text: 同一範圍上，均勻分布的熵最大

lec02bi2-u05-p3-sub2.name: u05 p3 sub
lec02bi2-u05-p3-sub2.text: On the same support, the uniform density has the largest entropy

lec02bi2-u05-p3-supp18.name: u05 p3 supp
lec02bi2-u05-p3-supp18.text:
[0,2] 上的理論最大熵是 ln 2 = 0.6931，表中 0.6932 的差距來自數值積分。
*On [0,2] the theoretical maximum is ln 2 = 0.6931; the 0.6932 in the table comes from numerical integration.*

lec02bi2-u05-p4-title1.name: u05 p4 title
lec02bi2-u05-p4-title1.text: 更有結構不代表更誠實

lec02bi2-u05-p4-sub2.name: u05 p4 sub
lec02bi2-u05-p4-sub2.text: More structure is not more honest

lec02bi2-u05-p4-fig3.name: u05 f5
lec02bi2-u05-p4-fig3.text: 左圖:同在 [0,2] 上面積都是 1 的四種密度,橘色粗線的均勻分布最平坦;右圖:對應的熵,均勻分布最高(0.693),三角形 0.500、雙峰 0.460、單峰鐘形 0.346 依序更低,琥珀色點線標出 ln 2

image.alt: 左圖:同在 [0,2] 上面積都是 1 的四種密度,橘色粗線的均勻分布最平坦;右圖:對應的熵,均勻分布最高(0.693),三角形 0.500、雙峰 0.460、單峰鐘形 0.346 依序更低,琥珀色點線標出 ln 2

lec02bi2-u05-p4-cap4.name: u05 p4 cap
lec02bi2-u05-p4-cap4.text:
左：四種密度在 $[0,2]$ 上面積都是 $1$，橘色粗線是均勻分布；右：對應的熵，越集中或結構越多越低，琥珀色點線標出 $H_{max}=\ln 2$。
*Left: four densities on $[0,2]$, each with area $1$; the thick orange line is uniform. Right: their entropies; more concentrated or structured means lower. The amber dotted line marks $H_{max}=\ln 2$.*

lec02bi2-u05-p5-title1.name: u05 p5 title
lec02bi2-u05-p5-title1.text: 峰值是你加的假設，不是資料說的

lec02bi2-u05-p5-sub2.name: u05 p5 sub
lec02bi2-u05-p5-sub2.text: A peak is an assumption you added, not what the data said

lec02bi2-u05-p5-wrong3.name: u05 p5 wrong
lec02bi2-u05-p5-wrong3.text:
✗  「有峰值、看起來有結構的分布，資訊量比較豐富，應該比較好。」
*"A peaked, structured density looks richer in information, so it should be better."*

lec02bi2-u05-p5-right4.name: u05 p5 right
lec02bi2-u05-p5-right4.text:
✓  恰好相反：峰值是自己加上去的假設。假設越多，熵越低，離「誠實」越遠。
*The opposite is true: the peak is an assumption you added. More assumptions mean lower entropy and less honesty.*

lec02bi2-u06-p1-title1.name: u06 p1 title
lec02bi2-u06-p1-title1.text: 把限制乘上 λ 加進熵

lec02bi2-u06-p1-sub2.name: u06 p1 sub
lec02bi2-u06-p1-sub2.text: Multiply the constraint by λ and add it to the entropy

lec02bi2-u06-p1-left3.name: u06 p1 left
lec02bi2-u06-p1-left3.text:
**限制** (constraint)
只知道 $x$ 在 $[x_1,x_2]$ 內非零；唯一限制是總機率為 $1$。
*Only the support $[x_1,x_2]$ is known; the single constraint is total probability $1$.*
$$
\int_{x_1}^{x_2}p(x)\,dx=1
$$

lec02bi2-u06-p1-right4.name: u06 p1 right
lec02bi2-u06-p1-right4.text:
**新目標** (new objective)
限制乘上 $\lambda$，加進熵。
*Add $\lambda$ times the constraint to the entropy.*
$$
H_L=-\int_{x_1}^{x_2}p(x)\bigl(\ln p(x)-\lambda\bigr)dx
$$

lec02bi2-u06-p1-supp5.name: u06 p1 supp
lec02bi2-u06-p1-supp5.text:
[補充] Lagrange 乘子法（Lagrange multiplier method）：把限制乘上未知係數 $\lambda$ 加進目標，就變成沒有額外限制的最佳化；解完再用限制定出 $\lambda$。
*[Added] Lagrange multipliers: multiply the constraint by an unknown $\lambda$ and add it to the objective, giving an unconstrained problem; fix $\lambda$ afterwards with the constraint.*

lec02bi2-u06-p2-sub2.name: u06 p2 sub
lec02bi2-u06-p2-sub2.text: Differentiate, set to zero, substitute the constraint

lec02bi2-u06-p2-s13.name: u06 p2 s1
lec02bi2-u06-p2-s13.text:
① 對 $p(x)$ 微分並令為 $0$：$\ln p(x)=\lambda-1$
*Differentiate with respect to $p(x)$ and set it to $0$.*

lec02bi2-u06-p2-s24.name: u06 p2 s2
lec02bi2-u06-p2-s24.text:
② 所以 $\hat{p}(x)=\exp(\lambda-1)$，是一個常數
*So $\hat{p}(x)=\exp(\lambda-1)$, a constant.*

lec02bi2-u06-p2-s35.name: u06 p2 s3
lec02bi2-u06-p2-s35.text:
③ 代回限制：$\exp(\lambda-1)=\dfrac{1}{x_2-x_1}$
*Substitute into the constraint.*

lec02bi2-u06-p2-side8.name: u06 p2 side
lec02bi2-u06-p2-side8.text:
結論：$\hat{p}(x)$ 在區間內是**常數**，每個位置機率相同。
*Result: $\hat{p}(x)$ is constant on the interval; every position is equally likely.*

lec02bi2-u06-p3-title1.name: u06 p3 title
lec02bi2-u06-p3-title1.text: 答案是區間內的均勻分布

lec02bi2-u06-p3-sub2.name: u06 p3 sub
lec02bi2-u06-p3-sub2.text: The answer is the uniform density on the interval

lec02bi2-u06-p3-note4.name: u06 p3 note
lec02bi2-u06-p3-note4.text:
已知的資訊只有「範圍落在 $[x_1,x_2]$」。既然如此，最誠實的回答是讓區間內每個位置機率相同。
*We only know the range lies in $[x_1,x_2]$, so the honest answer gives every position the same probability.*

lec02bi2-u06-p3-supp5.name: u06 p3 supp
lec02bi2-u06-p3-supp5.text:
一無所知時，最誠實的答案就是均勻分布。
*When you know nothing, the most honest answer is the uniform density.*

lec02bi2-u06-p4-title1.name: u06 p4 title
lec02bi2-u06-p4-title1.text: [0,2] 上的均勻分布熵是 ln 2

lec02bi2-u06-p4-sub2.name: u06 p4 sub
lec02bi2-u06-p4-sub2.text: The entropy of the uniform density on [0,2] is ln 2

lec02bi2-u06-p4-supp6.name: u06 p4 supp
lec02bi2-u06-p4-supp6.text:
[補充] 這一節是純代數推導，不另畫圖；形狀見上一單元的均勻密度與下一單元的 (a) 圖。
*[Added] This section is pure algebra and has no figure of its own; the shape appears in the uniform density of the previous unit and panel (a) of the next.*

lec02bi2-u07-p1-sub2.name: u07 p1 sub
lec02bi2-u07-p1-sub2.text: Three sets of constraints, three answers

lec02bi2-u07-p1-c13.name: u07 p1 c1
lec02bi2-u07-p1-c13.text:
**只知道定義域**
$[x_1,x_2]$
*only the support is known*
→ 均勻分布 (uniform)
$H=\ln(x_2-x_1)$

lec02bi2-u07-p1-c24.name: u07 p1 c2
lec02bi2-u07-p1-c24.text:
**$x\ge 0$，均值 $\mu$**
*support $x\ge0$, known mean*
→ 指數分布 (exponential)
$\frac{1}{\mu}e^{-x/\mu}$
$H=1+\ln\mu$

lec02bi2-u07-p1-c35.name: u07 p1 c3
lec02bi2-u07-p1-c35.text:
**均值 $\mu$、變異數 $\sigma^2$**
*known mean and variance*
→ 高斯分布 (Gaussian)
$H=\frac{1}{2}\ln(2\pi e\sigma^2)$

lec02bi2-u07-p1-supp6.name: u07 p1 supp
lec02bi2-u07-p1-supp6.text:
[補充] $\mu=1$ 的指數分布 $H=1.0000$；$\sigma^2=1$ 的高斯 $H=1.4189$。
*[Added] Exponential with $\mu=1$: $H=1.0000$. Gaussian with $\sigma^2=1$: $H=1.4189$.*

lec02bi2-u07-p2-title1.name: u07 p2 title
lec02bi2-u07-p2-title1.text: 限制條件決定曲線的形狀

lec02bi2-u07-p2-sub2.name: u07 p2 sub
lec02bi2-u07-p2-sub2.text: The constraints determine the shape of the curve

lec02bi2-u07-p2-fig3.name: u07 f6
lec02bi2-u07-p2-fig3.text: 三張小圖:(a) 只知道定義域 [0,2],最大熵分布是高度 0.5 的均勻分布,H=0.693;(b) 定義域 x≥0 且均值為 1,是遞減的指數分布 e^{-x},H=1.000;(c) 均值 0、變異數 1,是鐘形的高斯分布,H=1.419

image.alt: 三張小圖:(a) 只知道定義域 [0,2],最大熵分布是高度 0.5 的均勻分布,H=0.693;(b) 定義域 x≥0 且均值為 1,是遞減的指數分布 e^{-x},H=1.000;(c) 均值 0、變異數 1,是鐘形的高斯分布,H=1.419

lec02bi2-u07-p2-cap4.name: u07 p2 cap
lec02bi2-u07-p2-cap4.text:
(a) 只知道 $[0,2]$：平坦的均勻分布。(b) $x\ge 0$ 且均值 $1$：遞減的指數分布。(c) 均值 $0$、變異數 $1$：鐘形的高斯分布。
*(a) Only $[0,2]$ known: the flat uniform density. (b) $x\ge0$ and mean $1$: the decaying exponential. (c) Mean $0$, variance $1$: the bell-shaped Gaussian. Each x-axis follows its own support.*

lec02bi2-u07-p3-title1.name: u07 p3 title
lec02bi2-u07-p3-title1.text: 同一套做法，換限制就換答案

lec02bi2-u07-p3-sub2.name: u07 p3 sub
lec02bi2-u07-p3-sub2.text: Same recipe, different constraints, different answers

lec02bi2-u07-p3-supp19.name: u07 p3 supp
lec02bi2-u07-p3-supp19.text:
[補充] 這張表的熵不能直接互相比大小，因為三者的定義域不同；要比熵，必須在相同的定義域上比。
*[Added] The entropies in this table cannot be compared directly because the supports differ; compare entropy only on one common support.*

lec02bi2-u07-p4-title1.name: u07 p4 title
lec02bi2-u07-p4-title1.text: 限制條件決定答案，不是憑喜好

lec02bi2-u07-p4-sub2.name: u07 p4 sub
lec02bi2-u07-p4-sub2.text: The constraints decide the answer, not taste

lec02bi2-u07-p4-big3.name: u07 p4 big
lec02bi2-u07-p4-big3.text:
限制條件決定答案，
不是憑喜好挑一個分布。
*The constraints determine the answer;*
*you do not pick a density by taste.*

lec02bi2-u07-p4-supp4.name: u07 p4 supp
lec02bi2-u07-p4-supp4.text:
只知道平均與變異數時，高斯是最不武斷的答案。這與中央極限定理出發點不同，結論卻一致。
*With only the mean and variance known, the Gaussian is the least committal guess. This is independent of the central limit theorem, yet consistent with it.*

lec02bi2-u08-p1-title1.name: u08 p1 title
lec02bi2-u08-p1-title1.text: 貝氏推論看分布，最大熵選最不武斷

lec02bi2-u08-p1-sub2.name: u08 p1 sub
lec02bi2-u08-p1-sub2.text: Bayesian inference looks at the distribution; maximum entropy picks the least committal

lec02bi2-u08-p1-main3.name: u08 p1 main
lec02bi2-u08-p1-main3.text:
**貝氏推論** (Bayesian inference)

• 保留完整後驗，再積分得預測分布
*keep the full posterior, integrate for the predictive*
• 預測變異數 $\sigma^2+\sigma_N^2$
• 資料多時，與 MAP、ML 一致
*agrees with MAP and ML for large data*

lec02bi2-u08-p1-side14.name: u08 p1 side1
lec02bi2-u08-p1-side14.text:
**最大熵原理** (maximum entropy)
已知限制內，選熵最大、最不多加假設的分布。
*Within the known constraints, pick the largest-entropy density.*

lec02bi2-u08-p1-side25.name: u08 p1 side2
lec02bi2-u08-p1-side25.text:
定義域 → 均勻；再給均值 → 指數；再給變異數 → 高斯。
*Support → uniform; add the mean → exponential; add the variance → Gaussian.*

lec02bi2-u08-p2-title1.name: u08 p2 title
lec02bi2-u08-p2-title1.text: 從完整後驗走到最大熵

lec02bi2-u08-p2-sub2.name: u08 p2 sub
lec02bi2-u08-p2-sub2.text: From the full posterior to maximum entropy

lec02bi2-u08-p2-flow3.name: u08 p2 flow
lec02bi2-u08-p2-flow3.text:
**完整後驗**
預測變異數
$\sigma^2+\sigma_N^2$
*the full posterior*

lec02bi2-u08-p2-flow4.name: u08 p2 flow
lec02bi2-u08-p2-flow4.text:
**資料多**
與 MAP、ML
趨於一致
*large $N$: all agree*

lec02bi2-u08-p2-flow5.name: u08 p2 flow
lec02bi2-u08-p2-flow5.text:
**只有限制**
沒有其他資訊
*only the constraints*

lec02bi2-u08-p2-flow6.name: u08 p2 flow
lec02bi2-u08-p2-flow6.text:
**熵最大**
最不武斷的答案
*maximum-entropy answer*

lec02bi2-u08-p2-note10.name: u08 p2 note
lec02bi2-u08-p2-note10.text:
貝氏推論處理「參數不知道」；最大熵處理「只有限制，沒有其他資訊」。
*Bayesian inference handles "the parameter is unknown"; maximum entropy handles "only constraints, no other information".*

lec02bi2-frame-u01.name: lec02bi2-frame-u01
lec02bi2-frame-u01.text: 後驗保留完整的不確定性

lec02bi2-frame-u02.name: lec02bi2-frame-u02
lec02bi2-frame-u02.text: 資料增加使高斯後驗變尖

lec02bi2-frame-u03.name: lec02bi2-frame-u03
lec02bi2-frame-u03.text: 預測變異數要加上後驗變異數

lec02bi2-frame-u04.name: lec02bi2-frame-u04
lec02bi2-frame-u04.text: 資料多時三種估計一致

lec02bi2-frame-u05.name: lec02bi2-frame-u05
lec02bi2-frame-u05.text: 最大熵不偷偷加入假設

lec02bi2-frame-u07.name: lec02bi2-frame-u07
lec02bi2-frame-u07.text: 限制條件決定最大熵的答案

lec02bi2-frame-u08.name: lec02bi2-frame-u08
lec02bi2-frame-u08.text: 小結：兩個主題各留下什麼

cap-bayes.name: cap-bayes
cap-bayes.text: 貝氏推論：參數不知道時  Bayesian inference: unknown parameters

cap-maxent.name: cap-maxent
cap-maxent.text: 最大熵：只有限制時  Maximum entropy: only constraints
